decisions.state_note: o000: window approximately x106–170,y34–98; dark fragment along left edge has right contour slanting down-left, with white to its right. Fragment cropped; no endpoint established.

o001: window x74–138,y34–98 shows a thick dark band leaning upward-right, from about x91 at bottom to x109 at top; both ends are cropped. Detector agrees on upright and diagonal portions. Digit remains unclear.

o002: window x74–138,y66–130 shows a thick dark band slanting down-left through the left portion, cropped at top and bottom; another dark fragment enters at lower-right near (130,120). Their connection is unknown.

o003: window x74–138,y98–162 shows a dark left band bending right near the bottom, with a narrow white recess extending down to about y149; a dark region enters from the right near y112. Detector reports no concepts. Lower continuation remains cropped.
